name: llmproxy
description: Standalone GitHub Copilot proxy CLI with native service management

0.2.60: embed current release notes in the installed package for first-update compatibility
keep deriving update changelogs from the release commit message when available
preserve hardcoded release notes only as a backward-compatible final fallback
0.2.61: stabilize launchd service restart by avoiding explicit stop before kickstart on macOS
treat missing launchd bootout targets as already stopped during service recovery
cap forwarded Copilot tools to 128 on both /responses and /chat/completions
make claude:setup and model:set target the installed llmproxy service port when LLMPROXY_HOME is set
0.2.62: add explicit vision capability for providers with --vision flag in provider:add and provider:key
implement automatic fallback skip for non-vision providers when requests contain images
add provider:test command to verify vision capability of all configured providers
add reasoning_content support for Kimi and other thinking models
add qwen3.7-plus, deepseek-v4-pro, kimi-k2.6 to model-capabilities registry
0.2.63: support multiple instances of the same provider with different models via provider:add
fix update-service.sh: use docker-compose.production.yml and set LLMPROXY_HOME when missing
fix update-service.sh: graceful skip when Docker Compose is not installed
0.2.65: fix llmproxy test: accept metadata-only provider responses when request_summary confirms success
stabilize provider test fallback handling for delayed request_summary writes
0.2.66: fix self-update: resolve the installed CLI even when the global wrapper path is stale or missing
recreate the global llmproxy entrypoint after update so the shell command remains available immediately
ensure self-update preserves the currently hashed llmproxy path by rewriting it with sudo when necessary
0.2.68: fix self-update: always prefer the freshly installed package CLI over stale wrappers discovered in PATH
recreate the global llmproxy wrapper automatically when it is missing after update
protect the valid global wrapper from cleanup so llmproxy update cannot remove its own entrypoint
0.2.69: document in CLAUDE.md that every commit and push must include an llmproxy version bump first
0.2.70: fix self-update: recreate legacy wrappers such as /usr/bin/llmproxy after update
preserve standard wrapper paths during update cleanup to avoid removing the active command
0.2.71: fix self-update with nvm: preserve the caller's original npm global bin path before switching Node versions
recreate llmproxy in the original npm prefix so the command remains available in the user's active shell
0.2.72: feat: auto-escalation to better providers on repeated requests
add EscalationTracker — detects when the same user message is resent N times
automatically escalates to the next provider after threshold identical messages (LLMPROXY_AUTO_ESCALATE=1)
0.2.73: fix self-update: make generated wrappers point directly to the installed package CLI instead of another global wrapper
fix nvm update path so llmproxy remains callable after upgrading from an older user-global install
0.2.74: test: add 12 unit tests for EscalationTracker auto-escalation module
cover disabled/enabled modes, threshold escalation, multi-level, conversation isolation, cleanup, and eviction
0.3.01: strengthen self-update with automatic backup, post-update smoke test, and rollback on verification failure
verify the freshly installed CLI with version, config:list, and status before declaring success
restore the previously installed global package and restart the managed service automatically when the new build does not pass validation
0.3.02: fix Linux installers so user-local npm prefixes are installed and persisted correctly without stale wrapper resolution
make llmproxy test print the provider HTTP error details for failed quick inference probes
add regression coverage for installer PATH persistence and quick test HTTP error reporting
0.3.03: fix llmproxy update so GitHub CLI is no longer required as a prerequisite
allow self-update on lean Linux servers that only have git and npm installed
keep update preflight focused on real requirements used by the updater
0.3.04: migrate managed project and service configuration automatically during self-update
remove legacy config variables such as LLM_STATS_API_KEY, SENDGRID_*, LLMPROXY_SMART_*, LLMPROXY_METERING_SINK, and split MongoDB keys
reap port 7045 before restart both in self-update and in the one-line installer to avoid stale runtime conflicts
0.3.05: fix llmproxy update and uninstall so the CLI bypasses the local REST wrapper and runs directly in the invoking shell
avoid self-update deadlocks when a managed llmProxy service is already running on the same machine
keep automatic config migration and port-7045 cleanup from 0.3.04 intact
0.3.06: migrate legacy Claude settings from both the current project and the global ~/.claude/settings.json during config migration and self-update
run config migration even when update is launched outside a project directory
remove stale LLMPROXY_SMART_* and legacy key aliases from real on-disk Claude settings, not only from the effective runtime view
0.3.07: add a timeout to the remote package version probe used by llmproxy update
prevent llmproxy update from appearing stuck before installation when the latest-version check hangs on a slow or broken network
keep the global/project Claude settings migration introduced in 0.3.06
0.3.08: make llmproxy test fail when LLMPROXY_LLM_STATS_API_KEY is missing from both project and global Claude settings
align the quick provider test with the real Claude Code inference gate for the mandatory llm-stats key
keep provider health probing intact while preventing false positive 'ok' results for inference-ready validation
0.3.09: fix self-update and persistent install on Unix so they repair and preserve both llmproxy and llmp wrappers
remove stale llmp aliases during uninstall to avoid shadowing an updated global installation
prevent old user-local llmp shims from surviving updates and masking the system-wide CLI on Linux servers
0.3.10: make project-scoped config values inherit from the user's global ~/.claude/settings.json when local overrides are absent
show the effective project values together with a dedicated Global Claude configuration section in config:list
keep service configuration separate from Claude user defaults while making global fallbacks visible and testable
0.3.11: harden request logging so unwritable JSONL files no longer crash /v1/messages and provider tests
repair LLMPROXY_HOME ownership and writable runtime files automatically during persistent install and self-update
prevent legacy sudo-based upgrades from leaving root-owned runtime logs that break subsequent native service requests
0.3.12: fix Windows CLI preflight so update and persistent install detect npm via npm.cmd in SSH and non-interactive sessions
keep protected-prefix checks intact while avoiding false 'npm not found' failures on Windows hosts
add regression coverage for Windows update/install paths that resolve npm through the cmd wrapper
0.3.13: fix Windows persistent install so it packs the current llmproxy build before uninstalling the old global copy
prevent install:persistent from deleting its own package source on Windows during global reinstall
keep the npm.cmd compatibility path introduced in 0.3.12 for update and service bootstrap
0.3.14: fix Windows native service management by using nssm.exe when available instead of registering a raw .cmd wrapper with sc.exe
make Windows persistent install silence npm notice output and fail if the registered service is not actually active after startup
stop leaking the caller PATH into the generated Windows service wrapper and keep only the required Node runtime path
0.3.15: fix Windows self-update over SSH by silencing git clone, npm pack/install, and service restart native command streams inside the PowerShell updater
prevent harmless native command stderr/progress output from aborting llmproxy update with NativeCommandError on Windows hosts
keep the 0.3.14 nssm-based Windows native service manager and post-start activity verification intact
0.3.16: fix Windows global-service startup by using netstat-based port cleanup instead of lsof when LLMPROXY_GLOBAL_SERVICE=1
prevent the native Windows service from crashing immediately on startup because lsof is unavailable on Windows
add regression coverage for Windows listener discovery in the global port-guard path
0.3.17: fix Windows nssm services by launching the generated wrapper through cmd.exe and restoring the required Windows system PATH entries
ensure native Windows services can resolve built-in commands such as netstat while still prepending the managed Node runtime
keep the Windows port-guard fix from 0.3.16 while making the default nssm service configuration actually runnable
0.3.18: fix Windows global-service port probing by invoking netstat.exe explicitly instead of relying on extension-less command resolution
prevent native Windows startup from still failing on hosts where spawnSync cannot resolve netstat without the .exe suffix
keep the nssm wrapper-based startup and Windows system PATH restoration introduced in 0.3.17
0.3.19: fix Windows native startup on constrained environments by invoking C:\\Windows\\System32\\netstat.exe with an absolute path
avoid any remaining dependence on PATH-based native command resolution during global-service port cleanup on Windows
keep the wrapper-based nssm startup and previous Windows update/service fixes intact
0.3.20: fix Windows native services by making nssm launch node.exe directly instead of routing through a cmd wrapper
set the managed Windows service PATH explicitly inside nssm so server startup no longer depends on wrapper shell behavior
keep the absolute netstat.exe port-guard fix from 0.3.19 while removing the last fragile batch layer from native startup
0.3.21: fix Windows self-update over SSH by routing git, npm, and post-install CLI commands through a quiet Start-Process helper
prevent PowerShell NativeCommandError noise from aborting llmproxy update when git clone or npm emit progress on stderr
keep the 0.3.20 direct-node nssm startup while making the updater resilient in non-interactive remote sessions
0.3.22: fix Windows service status detection on localized hosts by recognizing numeric sc state codes such as STATO : 4 RUNNING
make llmproxy status report Service active: yes when the native service is running on non-English Windows installations
keep the 0.3.21 SSH-safe updater and 0.3.20 direct-node nssm startup unchanged
0.3.23: fix Windows update and persistent install by stopping the native service before replacing the global npm package
prevent EBUSY rename failures when npm install -g touches a live llmproxy directory owned by the running service
keep the localized Windows status fix from 0.3.22 and the SSH-safe updater from 0.3.21 intact
0.3.24: fix Windows self-update so Start-Process routes npm.cmd and other script-style entrypoints through the correct host executable
prevent local llmp update from failing with '%1 is not a valid Win32 application' when the updater hits cmd, PowerShell, or Node wrappers
keep the Windows service-stop protection from 0.3.23 while hardening the updater's launcher resolution
0.3.25: make Windows update fail early with explicit Administrator guidance when the native llmproxy service is still active in a non-elevated session
surface the real Windows service stop error instead of a generic failure message, so access-denied cases are diagnosable immediately
keep the 0.3.24 launcher fix for npm.cmd, PowerShell wrappers, and Node entrypoints intact
0.3.26: bypass the local REST wrapper for version, status, and service-management commands so self-diagnostics use the invoking CLI binary directly
prevent local update debugging on Windows from accidentally reading version or service responses from an older already-running service instance
keep the 0.3.25 Administrator preflight for active Windows services intact
0.3.27: fix local config commands so config:set/get/list/unset no longer proxy through the running service and accidentally use the service account Claude home
make llmproxy test read the effective LLMPROXY_LLM_STATS_API_KEY from configuration scopes instead of requiring Claude proxy markers in the project settings file
keep the 0.3.26 local self-diagnostics bypass intact while restoring correct global Claude key handling on Windows
0.3.28: validate the macOS self-update path end-to-end against the current persistent installation and Docker-backed service runtime
keep the 0.3.27 local config-scope fixes and LLMPROXY_LLM_STATS_API_KEY resolution behavior intact
ship a no-behavior-change release used to verify local llmp up reliability on macOS
0.3.29: fix update preflight so llmp up exits cleanly when the local CLI is already newer than the online version probe result
isolate config-list API tests from the developer's real global Claude settings on macOS and other local environments
keep the 0.3.28 macOS update validation release intact while removing a false-positive self-update path on symlinked dev installs
0.3.30: fix provider:add so only copilot uses the GitHub device-flow login and custom API-key provider instance ids stay on the API-key path
allow distinct custom provider instance ids to coexist even when they point to the same provider kind and default model
fix auto-escalation for free-model fallback chains so repeated failures can still promote across all-free candidates without leaking into paid providers
